gaps.title: Missing system action audit log
gaps.jtbd: When users interact with the system, I want their actions (who, when, what) to be logged in a dedicated journal, so that administrators can audit metadata changes and permission updates.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an authenticated user, When the user modifies document metadata or access rights, Then a record must be created in a central audit journal capturing the user's identity, timestamp, and details of the change.
gaps.reason: The brief explicitly requests 'журналирование действий пользователей (кто, когда и что изменил)', but the system only tracks authors of document versions, lacking a central, comprehensive journal for administrative and metadata actions.

gaps.title: Missing anti-virus scan on upload
gaps.jtbd: When a user uploads a file, I want the file to be scanned for malware, so that the knowledge base does not distribute infected documents.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a user uploading a new document or version, When the file is transferred to the server, Then it must be passed through an anti-virus scanner before being saved to the upload directory.
gaps.reason: The system accepts generic file uploads (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, etc.) from various users. In any public educational platform, it is a domain-standard requirement to scan uploaded files for malware to prevent security breaches and protect downstream users who download these materials.
